Synopsis:
The player meets Balthazar, the necromancer, in his temporary command centre in the Shar temple. They find him at an altar, repairing one of his damaged undead, while other minions bustle around. Balthazar has been sent by Ketheric Thorm to recover Nightsong, but has been unable to clear a path to her vault. He decides to recruit the player, upon recognising them as tadpoled. The player can agree or decline, and can possibly persuade him to loan his flesh golem to aid their exploration.

Cluster Contexts:
- SHA_Necromancer_Chosen.json: You find Balthazar in a makeshift command post inside the Shar temple, mending one of his damaged undead while other minions bustle about; he’s a necromancer sent by Ketheric Thorm to recover a relic called the Nightsong but has been unable to clear a path to its vault. Off-screen, the party’s progress through the temple has already put them in conflict with Shar’s dead (and apparently damaged Balthazar’s skeletons), and Balthazar’s troops have probed the player enough to identify them as a True Soul/tadpoled. He offers to recruit or conscript the player as a scout (and will stubbornly insist obedience), and helping him could be a route to Ketheric himself; the player can accept, refuse, or try to persuade Balthazar to lend his flesh golem to assist. Separately, Shadowheart’s book about a Shar temple and a “shadow curse” frames her immediate suspicion of the place and may influence how the party reacts.
- SHA_Necromancer_Barricade.json: The player is challenged by some skeleton warriors at a barricade outside the Necromancer's lair. The necromancer speaks through the dead warriors - his words in their dessicated voices.(this mayor may not follow on from an earlier scene with more skeletons controlled by the necromancer). A mindmeld convinces the necromancer to command his skeletons to grant entry. The scene ends with combat with the skeletons, or a shadowquake triggering a fight between player (+ skeletons) against sharran wraiths. Afterwards, the player is invited into Balthazar's inner sanctum.
- SHA_TadpoledSkeletons_Scouts.json: Player meets the skeletons controlled by Balthazar, the Necromancer, who is barricaded elsewhere in the temple. His skeletons meet the player in the hallway. The skeletons sense an attack and retreat to help defend the necromancer.The skeletons speak individually, in turns, but are all the mouthpieces of Balthazar, the necromancer. NOTE: the three skeletal voices/speakers can differ, but should flow in terms of tone as though they're ultimately coming from the one person - transmitting his words.
- COL_Necromancer_EnterRoom.json: A player walked into Balthazar's chambers in the colony, while Balthazar is alive, and was spotted by him (or one of his undead). Balthazar reacts with hostility, but players can convince him that they have been turned into thralls.This can only happen if Balthazar is alive at this point and you didn't try the Audience with the Absolute. If you did not send Nightsong to Ketheric, Balthazar would have died in combat in her prison.This dialog will also play when interacting with Balthazar in this route.
- MOO_Executioner.json: Dialogue with Z'rell when she's upstairs. This takes place after the execution scene, and involves Z'rell mind-melding to see how players dealt with the goblins, and testing their 'desire' to be one with the Absolute via a second mind-meld. She then gives them the mission to aid Balthazar, giving them the key to his chamber, and instructing them to find evidence of where he can be found.
